scope: Review newly surfaced ACadRust bindings and dual-backend downstream consumers; recheck already-catalogued acad-ts and dwg2png lineage without duplicating or upgrading their prior evidence.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research plus local plan inspection
sourceObservations: acadrust.js states that its N-API package consumes the unmodified acadrust Cargo dependency. The wrapper adds a Node integration/package boundary but does not introduce an independent DWG/DXF codec.

dwg2geo documents two backend modes: a native ACadRust adapter and an external-process route through LibreDWG dwgread plus GDAL ogr2ogr. Its README warns against geographic-correctness claims without source CRS or control-point evidence and says unsupported entities must not be silently discarded.
The existing plan already catalogs acad-ts as an ACadSharp port and dwg2png as an ACadRust-backed 2D renderer; those relationships were rechecked and their prior evidence grades were not changed.
No source inspected in this pass supplies a new independent DWG/DXF parser, a 3D solid semantic oracle, or native-CAD acceptance evidence.
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: prior peer-lineage and dwg2png consumer entries; composed comparator intake and implementation/validation cadence
method.evidenceRule: A language binding or wrapper retains the lineage of the parser library it loads. A dual-backend converter must be reported as separate parser/converter chains; results from different chains or fallback routes cannot be pooled. Geographic projection evidence requires independently known CRS/units/transforms and feature-level disposition.

reconfirmedExistingRoutes: acad-ts remains an ACadSharp-derived port, not an independent parser lineage.
dwg2png remains an ACadRust-backed 2D rendering consumer; its self-reported corpus does not supply independent parser or 3D-solid evidence.
peerExecutionReadinessRefinement: For a binding, record wrapper artifact and resolved parser crate/library versions separately, including the effective native module actually loaded.
For dwg2geo, keep native ACadRust and external LibreDWG/GDAL runs in separate evidence rows and bind CRS, units, transform inputs, backend selection, and per-feature source disposition.
Do not add these routes to CI or the per-slice loop; run only if an existing scoped implementation question has reproducible authorized inputs and expected outputs.
